log.msg: Read Saver.js, FileSaver.js, LocalStorageSaver.js, MemorySaver.js, workspace.js, readme.md, page.js in full before editing.

Bug 1 fixed: drain() wraps its loop in try/catch/finally so this.writing always clears, even on a rejecting write() — a rejected write now costs one save, not every save after it. LocalStorageSaver.write() also guards setItem with try/catch (QuotaExceededError), so the common failure never even reaches drain()'s catch.

Bug 2 design call: FileSaver.load() now rejects on any non-404 response instead of folding every failure into null — null still means genuinely absent. workspace()'s Item.open(store).then(...) gained a .catch() that renders an inline error and returns without seeding or calling root.save(), so a read failure can never overwrite the real /data/panels.json. Recorded in both modules' readme.md and ext/Panel/doc/decisions.md.

node --check clean on all four changed .js files (copied to scratchpad as .mjs first, per house rule). Playwright against the already-running port-80 dev server: /framework/ext/Saver/ and /framework/ext/Panel/ both load with zero console errors.

assign.outcome: **Both bugs fixed and verified live.** Saver.drain() (public/framework/ext/Saver/Saver.js) now wraps its write loop in try/catch/finally so this.writing always clears — a rejecting write() no longer wedges the queue forever. LocalStorageSaver.write() guards setItem (QuotaExceededError) the same way. FileSaver.load() (public/framework/ext/Saver/FileSaver.js) now rejects on any non-404 failure instead of folding every error into null; ext/Panel/workspace.js's workspace() (public/framework/ext/Panel/workspace.js) catches that rejection, shows an inline error, and never seeds/saves over a real document it failed to read. All ten doc/readme files that claimed either bug as open now read as applied, with the design call recorded in both modules' Decisions. /framework/ext/Saver/ and /framework/ext/Panel/ verified via Playwright on the running dev server: zero console errors.
